description: This file defines a class PDFProcessor that processes PDF files to extract text and images, including methods for chunking text and saving images extracted from PDF pages.

classes.name: PDFProcessor
classes.description: A class for processing PDF files to extract structured text and images, and saving images to a designated directory.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the PDFProcessor, setting up the images directory.

methods.name: process_pdf
methods.description: Processes a PDF file to extract text chunks and images, returning them as lists of dictionaries.

methods.name: _chunk_text
methods.description: Splits extracted text into manageable chunks with overlap, based on paragraph length and configured chunk size.
